audit: Independent final source and procedural coverage challenge of benchmark-v14
scope: 2023 English Uprising v23-10-12, standard 2–4-player multiplayer including required two-player Rival, optional standard CHOAM; no solo, Rival variants, six-player teams or cross-game expansions. Relevant official FAQ January 13 2025 clarifications included.

verdict.explanation: All existing requested parts are supported. One original printed Shaddam Signet benefit choice remains unasked. Legacy extraction-range precision also needs correction independently of semantic correctness.

source_key_findings.description: The lower-right original Shaddam ability includes two printed alternative benefit branches, while existing questions ask only its trigger/restriction and Sardaukar contracts. See genuine_additions.

Several early keys use bare extraction line ranges that fail to locate every asserted rule in the two supplied main extractions. Correct page-level citations generally identify the source, so these are locator defects rather than incorrect answers. Canonical exact source locators are independently supplied for every ID below.

examples.actual: E 886-890 / M 976-980; E902-907 concerns additional-card/component text.
E 1136-1141 / M 1243-1248; E1111-1117 instead covers Alliance and battle icons.

source_key_findings.description: Rival homogeneous conversions were verified visually in the original diagram. Original Shaddam left ability visibly says both contracts and only you; reserve-pool counts 18 and 16 are arithmetic consequences of those printed words and standard20/two public offers, not six-player rules. No conflicting digital transcription was consulted.

genuine_additions.question: On the original 2023 Shaddam Corrino IV Leader, what two alternative benefit branches does Emperor of the Known Universe offer when Signet Ring is used on an Agent turn? State what is gained in the first branch and what must be paid and gained in the other branch. May both branches be taken from that activation?
genuine_additions.answer: Choose one branch: gain 1 Solari and recruit 1 troop, or pay 3 Solari to gain 1 Influence with any one Faction. The OR makes these alternatives, so the same activation does not grant both. The recruited troop goes from your supply to your garrison and cannot be deployed that turn because the printed deployment restriction already applies. The restriction timing is existing coverage, not the novel claim.

source_references.region: Lower-right Emperor of the Known Universe ability: first icon group (1 Solari and one troop), OR, then 3 Solari arrow to one freely chosen Faction Influence. Approximate image bounds x=448..641, y=387..421 in the 778x448 image.

genuine_additions.novelty: A distinct, printed source-defined alternative outcome and cost/reward choice. Q43 asks starting contract ownership/acquisition and restriction duration; Q93 asks restriction onset against normal effect ordering; Q72 asks generic Signet activation. None asks what either Shaddam benefit branch does or requests the OR choice. This is not a changed number/name within another question, and no incidental key text elsewhere supplies this coverage. The branch icons are part of the independently inspected authorized original Leader, not inferred from six-player, digital or later-product material.
